The linked #20408 explicitly says not to change RPC selector compatibility; retain the legacy fallback for RPC while removing it for service-peer, unless the linked requirement is intentionally being expanded.

replies.body: I intentionally expanded this PR to include RPC. Both RPC and service-peer conventions now require the preview selector for 3.0, as documented in the PR title, description, and breaking-change entry. The legacy RPC fallback is intentionally removed; default telemetry and explicit `general.rpc.semconv` configuration remain unchanged.
